name: Imp
description: The lmp pestering the merchants of Novigrad turned out to be a doppler. These monsters usually avoid confrontation - to everyone's great relief, for when pinned they become extremely dangerous.
story: Really wanna see an angry witcher? Do you? — Conversation overheard on the streets of Novigrad
lore: Fighting them quickly turns into a fight against oneself. Or, to be precise, against a mirror image gifted with one's own strengths and abilities. In a conflict with such even odds, only luck - or destiny - decides the victor.
habitat: Primeval forests, forgotten ruins, and places of old power

encounter.title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt and expansions
encounter.note: Game reference cross-check; the trail is associated with Velen, Skellige, Toussaint.
